limits: Each boot is a full power cycle of the board followed by a kexec handoff from the installed Linux; the firmware loads no Slime file and internal storage is not written.
This records the root-boot fixture reaching READY. No component reported ready, and the board still resets about ten seconds after kernel entry when the system keeps working.
Only sampled fields differ between the two boots: the timer poll count and the raw counter readings. Every semantic field, including the terminal READY line, is identical.
